component.name: openExpress
component.summary: Manage your Garmin watch on Linux

description.p: openExpress is an unofficial Linux app for Garmin watches connected with a USB cable. It syncs the watch with Garmin Connect and installs software updates, maps, Connect IQ apps and music.

openExpress to nieoficjalna aplikacja dla Linuksa do zegarków Garmin podłączonych kablem USB. Synchronizuje zegarek z Garmin Connect oraz instaluje aktualizacje oprogramowania, mapy, aplikacje Connect IQ i muzykę.

ul.li: Upload activities, sleep, HRV and other health data to Garmin Connect
Wysyłanie aktywności, snu, HRV i innych danych zdrowotnych do Garmin Connect
Send courses, workouts and apps queued in Garmin Connect to the watch
Przesyłanie na zegarek kursów, treningów i aplikacji z kolejki Garmin Connect
Install watch software updates and free maps such as TopoActive
Instalacja aktualizacji oprogramowania i darmowych map, np. TopoActive
Install, update and remove Connect IQ apps and watch faces
Instalacja, aktualizacja i usuwanie aplikacji oraz tarcz Connect IQ
Copy music, podcasts, audiobooks and playlists
Kopiowanie muzyki, podcastów, audiobooków i playlist
Sync automatically in the background when the watch is connected
Automatyczna synchronizacja w tle po podłączeniu zegarka
No telemetry
Bez telemetrii

description.p: The one-time setup reads the data needed to talk to Garmin's servers from your own copy of the official Garmin Express installer for Windows. openExpress is not affiliated with, endorsed by or supported by Garmin Ltd. Garmin, fēnix, Garmin Connect and Garmin Express are trademarks of Garmin Ltd. or its subsidiaries.

Jednorazowa konfiguracja odczytuje dane potrzebne do komunikacji z serwerami Garmina z Twojej kopii oficjalnego instalatora Garmin Express dla Windows. openExpress nie jest powiązany z Garmin Ltd., nie jest przez nią zatwierdzony ani wspierany. Garmin, fēnix, Garmin Connect i Garmin Express są znakami towarowymi Garmin Ltd. lub jej spółek zależnych.

screenshot.caption: Maps on the watch and free maps to install

ul.li: Fixed: the report dialog added in 0.4.1 stayed in memory after it was closed, and the window could occasionally crash afterwards.
Fixed: files that are already on the device (same size and MD5) are no longer offered as updates, e.g. map support files the device briefly does not list right after it is plugged in.
Update types and their importance are shown with readable, translated names.
The window and the command-line tool warn not to unplug the device while it is in use.
The app keeps a log file of what it does, with rotation. Serial numbers, unit IDs, addresses, tokens, e-mail addresses and file names are filtered out before anything is written.
The device report says where the log is and can attach its filtered end.

Connect IQ apps can be installed, updated and removed on devices that hide their app folder (e.g. fēnix 8) over a direct USB connection; the order of widgets is kept. Version from source only; the Flatpak queues such apps in Garmin Connect.
The order of apps and widgets can be restored from a copy of the app list, which is saved before every change.
Primary training device: shown and set from the window and the command line.
Playlists can be added on the Music page.
Sync checks the upload consent of the Garmin account before uploading; the --include-consent option was removed.
The app waits for a device that is still starting after it is plugged in.
Devices that report a name over USB (e.g. Edge 1050) are now detected.
The Music page and the music command show only what the device supports.
Messages say "device" instead of "watch"; the files command counts every file once.

description.p: Sync and Connect IQ now refuse a watch that is not registered to the signed-in Garmin account.
Fixes "Operation not supported" when writing courses, workouts, maps, apps or music to the watch from the Flatpak.
The window opens without flickering: the watch picture is shown at once from the cache instead of being downloaded every time.
The window remembers its size and whether it was maximized.
Fixes "not authorized (HTTP 401)" when uploading new activities.
New "Report a Device or Problem" window and openexpress report command: a report for GitHub without serial numbers or other identifiers.
Reliability release with about 50 fixes from a code review, among others:

ul.li: A damaged activity file no longer stops every sync
Temporary server or network errors no longer lose data; files are retried
Failed writes of software, maps or apps are removed from the watch
Backups never delete the newest backup or unrelated folders
The window cannot be closed while files are being written to the watch
New layout with a sidebar that adapts to narrow windows
Watch overview with a picture of the watch, storage, last sync and software status
Preferences window, keyboard shortcuts and a banner when you are not logged in
Search for maps and built-in activities, Connect IQ app icons

description.p: Running openExpress without a command opens the application window.

ul.li: Flatpak package
Background sync can be turned on in the window
